name: date-picker
title: Date Picker
summary: A date field that opens a calendar, for one date, several dates or a range.
description: A date field with a calendar in a popup. The field reads as words in the locale: a date ("Mar 10, 2025") or a range as one phrase ("Mar 10 – 28, 2025", "Mar 28 – Apr 2, 2025", "Dec 30, 2025 – Jan 2, 2026"), with the calendar icon at its start. A press anywhere on the field opens the calendar and leaves the caret in the text, so a date can still be typed: the shown text, the locale's numeric date, ISO, month names, a range with a dash or "to"; it is read on Enter and when focus leaves. The calendar is the shared popup with the calendar's views (days, months, years); it grows out of the field from the pointer and is instant from the keyboard. Choosing a date writes it and closes the popup. Single dates, several dates or a range, min / max, unavailable days, week start and locale. Behaviour, focus and ARIA come from the Zag date-picker machine, through Ark UI; the text is the component's own (helper `date-text.ts`).

anatomy.description: The engine's root; data-state=open|closed. Never narrower than its dates (min-width: min-content), so a caller's width widens the field but never cuts a date.

The shared control (`lib/control.ts`), field kind: its sizes (xs 24 · sm 28 · md 32 · lg 36) and looks (outline, subtle, ghost) holding the input and the icon. A text field: the accent ring shows for every kind of focus and while the calendar is open. data-invalid, data-disabled from the engine.

One text input over the whole control, as wide as its text (field-sizing: content) and growing into a wider field. Shows the dates in words in the locale; a range is one phrase (Intl formatRange). role=combobox, aria-haspopup=dialog, aria-expanded; it is the engine's trigger (focus comes back to it). Placeholder "Select date" / "Select dates". dir=auto; 16px on coarse pointers. With a name, one hidden input per date carries the ISO date.

The calendar icon (Phosphor calendar-blank, bold) at the field's start, 14px ink-3 like an input group's icon, drawn over the input's start padding (control padding + 14px + 8px gap); takes no pointer, aria-hidden. Mirrors to the right end right-to-left.
Placed by the engine under the control; rendered in a portal. Exposes --transform-origin, --available-height.
role=application, named by triggerLabel; the shared popup surface (`lib/popup.ts`) with 8px padding, holding the calendar's views (the Calendar adapter's CalendarViews: header, grid, dates).

value.description: Selected dates as ISO strings ("2025-03-12"). single: one; range: the start and the end.

selectionMode.description: range: a start and an end, shown as one phrase in the one input; the calendar stays open until the end is chosen. multiple: the dates joined by a middle dot.

placeholder.description: Shown while no date is chosen. Without it: "Select date" ("Select dates" for a range).

triggerLabel.description: The calendar popup's accessible name (the field itself is the trigger).

size.description: The shared control's sizes (`lib/control.ts`), dimensions only: xs 24px, sm 28px, md 32px, lg 36px.

variant.description: The shared control's looks (`lib/control.ts`), at every size. outline: the form field (field colour, hairline). subtle: the inspector (inset grey, no edge). ghost: nothing until touched. Focused, open and invalid look the same in every variant.

min.description: Earliest date that can be chosen (ISO).

max.description: Latest date that can be chosen (ISO).

unavailable.description: Dates that cannot be chosen (ISO). Also takes isDateUnavailable(date).

defaultFocusedValue.description: The date the calendar opens on when no value is set. Without it: today.

startOfWeek.description: 0 Sunday … 6 Saturday. Without it: the locale's.

locale.description: BCP 47 tag for the field's words and digits, the calendar's names and the typed forms it reads. Without it: the LocaleProvider's.

timeZone.description: Where "today" is taken. Without it: the browser's.

name.description: Form field name: one hidden input per date carries it, as an ISO date ("2025-03-12").

placement.description: Preferred side; flips when there is no room.

defaultOpen.description: The calendar is open at mount: it lands with no entrance (nothing plays on first paint) and takes no focus; until it first closes it stays on its placement's side (no flip), in the room its host reserved. For an example or a page whose subject is the calendar; it closes as usual (Escape, a press outside, a choice).

a11y.role: combobox (the text input, aria-haspopup=dialog) + dialog-like grid (role=application)
keyboard: Tab reaches the input (one tab stop; Chrome selects its text, so typing replaces it)

Typing writes a date or a range; the calendar follows what is read so far; Enter or leaving the field takes it (text that is not a date, or an unavailable date, gives the field its value back). Escape while typing restores the value
Arrow Down opens the calendar at once (no animation) with focus on the selected date, or the focused one
In the calendar: the calendar's keys (arrows, Page Up / Down, Home / End, Enter / Space), all instant
Choosing a date closes the calendar (in range mode, the end date does) and focus returns to the input
Escape closes the calendar and returns focus to the input; Tab moves through the calendar's header and grid
notes: Give it a visible label or an aria-label; the input carries the name.

A press anywhere on the field (the icon included) opens the calendar and keeps the caret in the text; a tap on a touch screen opens it without the on-screen keyboard (focus goes to the calendar), and a tap while it is open is for typing.
Opening and closing from the keyboard are instant; the pointer gets the popup's scale-in out of the field.

motion: popup: the shared popup surface (`lib/popup.ts`): opacity + scale from motion.popup-scale out of the field, duration.popup, easing.out-strong; closes at duration.fast; instant when opened or closed from the keyboard
control: fill over duration.fast, ring over duration.base; nothing else in the field moves (the text changes at once: it is a value)
calendar: the calendar's own motion (colour on hover and selection, press scale from the pointer; paging instant)
